scope: bounded training-only feasibility pilot; promotion conditional on later matched R9 ensemble evaluation
registered_before_outer_scoring: See timing-run manifest.json, written before pilot fitting and outer scoring
split: seed 711: 60% upstream, 20% residual fit, 10% inner selection, 10% outer scoring; selected complete user histories
baseline: Fresh regularized user/item bias fit, explicitly weaker than R9-LAT-A2h
geometry: Four seeded random item coordinates; independent of all ratings; profiles use upstream ratings centered at fixed 3.6 with all candidate-movie contributions removed

detection.cutoff: 99th percentile of permutation maximum scores across all tested movies/windows
detection.null: Permute movie assignments within 16-week strata, preserving stratum movie totals and all dated user events; destroy within-stratum timing and movie/user associations

pilot_gate: Full correction improves overall outer RMSE over base, smooth, bias and placebo by at least 0.0001
promotion_gate: Later matched full-ensemble improvement >=0.0001, all five user folds improve, paired user-cluster 95% interval favors correction
budget: 100-user timing sample then bounded default 500-user pilot, single BLAS thread; no checkpoint retraining or changes to concurrent work

audit.neighboring_workspaces: Read-only script search found no audience-shock implementation
audit.clean_reusable_artifacts: artifacts/validation absent; existing geometry and prediction provenance not verified for fresh pilot split
audit.resource_snapshot: 32 GiB machine; three concurrent training workers about 22 GiB combined RSS
audit.decision: Use fresh weak base and rating-independent geometry for bounded screen; defer strong baseline retraining

restrictions: No ensemble gain claim from weak pilot
